source: Observed command outputs transcribed for audit; original T0 logs stay in their run directories.
items: First T0: Texture(source) is not a supported Panda constructor: 14 passed, 13 setup errors. Fixed with documented makeCopy; finally replaced pooled copy with direct Texture.read to avoid retaining a redundant source copy.
First rendering tool omitted HUD.resize; overlapping HUD in first capture excluded. Production HUD was unchanged.

Third render using Asphalt02 grayscale roughness: GPU upload assertion because RGB format was forced onto one-channel image. Fixed by retaining source format; grayscale JPEG regression fixture added. No successful third-run summary.
Initial UV seam test read unused vertices in a shared flattened vertex table: one passed, one failed. Corrected to inspect only primitive-referenced vertices.
